family_scope: Independent V3 reconstruction of the stronger objective placebo/nocebo physiology claim, not replacement by generic intervention, comparator or response definitions.
required_results: The exact quarter-One and three-quarter-One expectation/body carriers are the two preimages of half-One and together complete One; the two orientations are held labels, never a positive/negative signed number.
Expectation can alter route selection only among already reachable positive physiological states; it cannot create an absent cure or exceed the retained organism/intervention boundary.
Expectation, assigned intervention, blinding, reported outcome, objective biomarker, adverse event, missing/null row and bounded follow-up remain distinct in every placebo/nocebo claim.
Post-seal external comparison must establish whether objective physiological effects are observed and preserve adverse, absent, unresolved and report-only results without conflation.
admission_rule: All three formal mechanisms and one complete empirical family claim must enumerate one unique survivor, pass four unfavorable controls, reconstruct independently and enter through the untouched sealed engine in order.
prohibited_shortcuts: No V1/V2 answer or external placebo result selects a survivor.
No signed negative nocebo magnitude is used; opposing orientation is a held label.
No subjective report is relabelled as an objective physiological measurement.
No generic trial-method claim substitutes for the stronger physiological mechanism.
No engine, verifier, authority seal, old receipt or old claim is edited.
No numerical absence, negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, fitted or free proof magnitude is admitted.
